parameters.name: AdditionalVolumes
parameters.description: The file systems that you want to mount.

sub_parameters.name: JobQueue
sub_parameters.description: The queue name of the file system to be mounted.

sub_parameters.name: LocalDirectory
sub_parameters.description: The on-premises mount directory of the file system to be mounted.

sub_parameters.name: Location
sub_parameters.description:
The storage location of the file system to be mounted. Valid values:

*   OnPremise: The file system is stored in a hybrid cloud.
*   PublicCloud: The file system cluster is stored in a public cloud.

sub_parameters.name: RemoteDirectory
sub_parameters.description: The remote directory to which the file system is mounted.

sub_parameters.name: Roles
sub_parameters.description: The array of the nodes to which the file system is mounted.

sub_parameters.name: VolumeId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the file system to be mounted.

sub_parameters.name: VolumeMountOption
sub_parameters.description: The mount option of the file system to be mounted.

sub_parameters.name: VolumeMountpoint
sub_parameters.description: The endpoint of the mount target of the file system.

sub_parameters.name: VolumeProtocol
sub_parameters.description:
The protocol type of the file system to be mounted. Valid values:

*   NFS
*   SMB

sub_parameters.name: VolumeType
sub_parameters.description: The type of the file system to be mounted. Set the value to NAS.
